h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Pali

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Pali

items.pText: Pali sits in the Marwar region of Rajasthan, a dry district known for its textile dyeing and printing units. Summers are very hot and dust storms are common before the monsoon. Fine dust is hard on anything that moves, and on a playground that means the springs, bearings and pivots in swings, see-saws, spring riders and merry-go-rounds.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 710 km from Pali, and sends it to Rajasthan by road. Our installation team or a dealer installs it at schools, societies, factory colonies and public gardens. Share your site size, the age group and a few photos. We will suggest pieces that suit the conditions and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

richText.heading: Looking after moving parts in a dusty climate

c: After a dust storm, wipe down the moving parts and listen for grinding or squeaks when the equipment is used. Those sounds usually mean dust has got into a bearing or a swing fitting. Our springs, bearings and spare parts carry a one-year warranty, and the frames and roto-moulded parts carry three years.

items.q: Does dust damage playground equipment in Pali?
items.a: Dust mainly affects moving parts such as bearings and springs. Wiping them down after a storm and checking them regularly keeps them working smoothly.

items.q: Which equipment needs the least maintenance?
items.a: Fixed pieces such as climbers and slides have no moving parts and need little more than cleaning. Swings, see-saws and merry-go-rounds need periodic checks.

items.q: Do you supply schools and colonies in Pali district?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai and install through our team or a dealer. Nearby cities such as Jodhpur and Udaipur are covered the same way.
